capabilities.name: Supabase auth + session restore
capabilities.description: Supabase email/password + OTP sign-in in SPA; server validates Bearer via /auth/v1/user; HttpOnly SameSite=Lax refresh cookie + HMAC session-restore endpoints.
capabilities.mature_endpoint_role: Foundation for every authenticated stage (client review, approval, control room).
capabilities.original_intent: Single sign-in for founder and clients across site00.com.
capabilities.current_truth: Server token validation is real (api/_lib/auth.ts:15-46). Client UI auth state lives in localStorage (isSignedIn/currentUser, baw_auth_backup cookie). Password-reset completion page is a stub (never calls updateUser). Open signUp/OTP shouldCreateUser:true lets anyone self-register; nothing binds account to an invite. No MFA, no device/session list.
capabilities.gap: Complete password reset; invite-bound sign-up (shouldCreateUser:false outside invite); stop trusting localStorage user.role; MFA + session revoke later.
evidence: api/_lib/auth.ts:15-46 — getAuthUser validates Bearer against Supabase /auth/v1/user
api/session-cookie.ts:17-31,54-55 — HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookies; 503 if SESSION_COOKIE_SECRET missing
/tmp/claude-0/gz/findings/auth_registry_notes.md §4 — reset page stub (Site00ResetPasswordPage.tsx:11), open signUp, no MFA

capabilities.name: Founder/admin gating via ADMIN_EMAILS

capabilities.mature_endpoint_role: Protects FOUNDER_CONTROL_ROOM / production workspace from clients and public.
capabilities.original_intent: Only the founder (and studio staff) reach /admin and paid generation.
capabilities.current_truth: All api/admin/* handlers call resolveAdminAuth (except OAuth callback which uses CSRF state). Fallback DEFAULT_ADMIN_EMAILS includes admin@frontalslayer.com and kateena.armstrong@frontalslayer.com when ADMIN_EMAILS unset. FOUNDER_PRIVILEGED_ADMIN_EMAIL hard-coded. Client AdminGuard has TEMPORARY_SITE00_ADMIN_BYPASS_ON_PREVIEW = true; Site00AccountRouteGuard bypassed by ?designPreview=1/?goldenDiffCapture=1. No role table.
capabilities.gap: Require ADMIN_EMAILS (no fallback) or DB role table; remove UI preview bypasses from production build; single requireFounder wrapper applied to every founder-only route.
evidence: api/_lib/adminAuth.ts:10-21 — DEFAULT_ADMIN_EMAILS fallback with Frontal Slayer emails
src/routes/Site00AdminRoutes.tsx:72 — admin routes mounted under AdminGuard

capabilities.name: API route auth policy / middleware
capabilities.description: Per-route authentication policy for the Express-mounted Vercel-style handlers (server/routes.ts).
capabilities.mature_endpoint_role: Ensures generation/canon/capture endpoints only reachable by founder; client endpoints project-scoped.
capabilities.current_truth: No middleware: server/index.ts mounts ~60 handlers via app.all with no auth layer. ~20 handlers (twin-v2-*, twin-v3-*, opus-native, sol-design-bench, design-asset-reconstruction, expression-engine, master-skin, campaign-package incl delete_asset_permanent, page-mirror, implementation-snapshots, astral-world-assets/avatar-library) call no auth helper; some rely on body flag founderConfirmedSpend:true. Paid providers (FAL/OpenAI/Grok/Anthropic) reachable anonymously.
capabilities.gap: Shared withAuth({policy}) wrapper + route-table declaring PUBLIC|TOKEN|CLIENT|ADMIN|FOUNDER per entry, enforced in server/index.ts, with a test asserting every API_ROUTES entry declares a policy.
evidence: server/index.ts:118-126 — for (const {path,handler} of API_ROUTES) app.all(path, ...) with no auth
api/site00/twin-v2-visual-concept.ts:79 — founderConfirmedSpend body flag as only guard

Only intake invites (worldIntakeService) implement hashed token/TTL/revoke and can be reused as pattern. MAGIC_LINK_REQUESTED email wired:false.

capabilities.name: Row Level Security coverage
capabilities.description: Postgres RLS across ~216 SITE 00 tables.
capabilities.mature_endpoint_role: Defense-in-depth for all project data across every stage.
capabilities.original_intent: Tables deny anon; API service role is sole path.
capabilities.current_truth: RLS enabled on 213/216; missing on site00_astral_avatars, site00_production_invalidation_events, site00_production_dependency_edges. Nearly all policies are service_role-only (no per-project/member RLS). site00_brand_creative_context (20260910180000) and site00_page_concept_generation_runs (20260921120000) have `for all using(true) with check(true)` with no TO role → world read/write via public anon key. No storage.objects policies; single public bucket.
capabilities.gap: Fix two open policies (TO service_role), enable RLS on 3 tables, private bucket(s) + signed URLs, later per-project RLS via members.

notes: Audited at main 6f63aaa (read-only). CI: last fully green main run 2026-09-28 (47e2d7e) which auto-promoted frontend; every main run since failed at `test` or was cancelled, so site00.com frontend updates since then come only from manual GitHub Release ZIPs (v5–v9 on 2026-10-05) while Railway deploys API from main directly → frontend/API drift. Latest failing test causes include production Supabase missing migrations (CI tests run against live DB). Client sites have no hosting/deploy path at all; project runtimes only render inside site00.com in design-preview mode. No error tracking, uptime monitoring, rate limiting, security headers, legal pages, backups plan or staging. Email is rendered but never sent. Blocker list deliberately limited to: API auth wrapper, role spoof, RLS open policies, anon fallback, admin bypass, auth/reset+invites, legal pages, client data firewall, email send, CI+migrations, client site hosting/domain/launch flow. Could not read repo Actions variables (proxy 403); auto-promote inferred from 2026-09-28 run executing deploy_frontend.
